# Product Brief

A tiny TODO CLI for collaborative teams. Goals:
- capture tasks quickly with clear descriptions
- keep a lightweight sync story for demos
- ensure every task has traceability to notes and code (coderefs)

See [[communities/product]] for launch framing.
